title: ScsPartyRegistrationRequest
description: SCS-CAP-02 party identity registration request: every ScsPartyIdentity field a submitter provides. Not in the request, because the system sets them: partyId (database-generated), partyVersion (1 on registration), schemaVersion, registeredAt, registeredBy and provenance.submittedBy (the authenticated actor), provenance.recordedAt, registrationStatus (REGISTERED on registration) and verificationAssessments (recorded separately; registration is not verification). Country codes are checked by the capability against ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, so an unrecognised code is refused with the contract's COUNTRY_CODE_UNRECOGNISED rather than a schema error.

countryOfRegistration.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase (checked by the capability).

countryOfOperation.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase (checked by the capability). Optional.

identityEvidence.title: ScsPartyIdentityEvidenceInput
identityEvidence.description: What documents support this identity (ScsPartyIdentity.identityEvidence). Evidence ids are recorded, not verified. Evidence ids are lowercase canonical UUIDs, so a duplicate within one request is always caught here.
